design_description: De novo CDRH3 redesign of trastuzumab Fv; shortlist rank 1 of 15. CDRH3 WASSSEYYFD, 7 mutations from trastuzumab (30% identity, 4 positions clear of the <=70% identity rule). Passes the challenge novelty filter (Hamming >=2 from all 525,063 provided loops) and is absent from the provided screen; the actual distance to the nearest provided loop is not recorded in the shortlist. Boltz-2 forward fold on the HER2 template: ipTM 0.968, min_ipAE 0.313, binder pTM 0.993, binder pLDDT 98.49, 2.39 A from the designed pose, epitope overlap 1.0 vs the design, HER2 fit 0.46 A. FACS-trained classifier P(high binder) 0.387; SPR-trained ridge predicted KD 18.22 nM (pKD 7.74). Co-generated in her2-novel-s1 as her2_cdrh3_3 with 18 interface H-bond pairs; CDRH3 cluster 0. Selected in the final 4. VL R66G, measured dTm +4.9 C on trastuzumab scFv by DSF (Okazaki et al. 2023, ACS Omega 8:22945, PMID 37396255), binding unchanged.
